privacy_checks.check: Stage 03 telemetry provenance matches the active implementation identity.
privacy_checks.evidence: rag/ingestion.py defines stage=03, stage_revision=1, attempt=3, agent=data_rag and contract_version=stage03-r1-a3; the focused telemetry regression asserts attempt 3 on every emitted lifecycle payload.

privacy_checks.check: Lifecycle telemetry remains compact, allowlisted, measured, and status-aware.
privacy_checks.evidence: _emit filters every payload through _TELEMETRY_ALLOWED_FIELDS and records non-negative monotonic latency_ms plus compact counts, status, degraded, Vector/Graph status, run/version/adapter/embedding identity, provider hash, and snapshot fingerprint fields.

privacy_checks.check: Archive-provider configuration and identity do not emit or persist secrets, paths, raw provider IDs, URLs, or archive contents.
privacy_checks.evidence: Historical providers require a stable identity, but only its SHA-256 provider_identity_hash enters request identity, telemetry, and checkpoint state. JsonArchiveProvider derives provider_id from archive bytes, exposes no logging call, and ingestion sanitizes config failures before capture or emission.

privacy_checks.check: Adapter, embedding, request, and materialization fingerprints expose no raw evidence payload.
privacy_checks.evidence: Adapter identity is limited to schema/table/RPC; embedding identity is limited to validated model/version/cache-schema strings; persisted materialization state contains SHA-256 values over ordered canonical document/evidence/chunk IDs, counts, boundaries, and status only. No document text, chunk text, title, URL, prompt, headers, credentials, provider payload, or raw tool result is serialized into IngestionManifest.

privacy_checks.check: Fail-closed checkpoint mismatch and resume outcomes are observable without leaking mismatch values.
privacy_checks.evidence: Request mismatches produce sanitized INGESTION_RESUME_SNAPSHOT_MISMATCH on checkpoint.failure and pipeline.failure; materialization mismatches produce resume.failure and pipeline.failure with status=failed, degraded=true, stage statuses, counts, and only the candidate snapshot hash. Exact matches emit checkpoint.load=resumed, vector.resume or resume.skip.

privacy_checks.check: Untrusted exception text remains absent from checkpoint, telemetry, capture payloads, and CLI-visible manifest state.
privacy_checks.evidence: StageStatus accepts deterministic INGESTION_* codes only, _capture_sanitized reports RuntimeError(error_code), and the secret/raw-payload/private-URL sentinel regression passed.

privacy_checks.check: Same-content revisions, dataset versions, retrieval times, and effective observations do not broaden observability persistence.
privacy_checks.evidence: AlphaProcessor preserves distinct canonical evidence/chunk IDs while the checkpoint/materialization layer observes only ordered hashes and counts. Raw canonical Vector evidence remains in the product data path and is not copied into telemetry, checkpoint, or this artifact.

privacy_checks.check: No chain-of-thought, brain_reasoning, full filing text, raw article chunk, duplicated tool payload, secret, token, or header was added to observability persistence by attempt 3.
No external tracing service was initialized or contacted by this pass.
